intro.html: You don’t have to leave Google all at once. Pick the service you use most, swap it for one of these, and move on to the next when you’re ready. Each list shows the top picks from privacytools.io, in their order.

intro.label: Take your data with you
intro.html: Before you switch, download a copy of everything with Google Takeout. See De-Google Yourself for the full walkthrough.
